crossRefs.note: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah…
His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These…
the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

people.name: Gedor
people.line: Region where Simeonites sought pasture for their flocks

translations.web: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
translations.bsb: and they journeyed to the entrance of Gedor, to the east side of the valley, in search of pasture for their flocks.
translations.kjv: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
